name: Single-Threaded Max Compression Timeout
provenance: Reconstructed case from local development; project-specific origin label redacted.

ground_truth.explanation: Running single-threaded xz with extreme compression (-9e --threads=1) on a 1.38 GB tarball exceeds operational time budget, triggering watchdog SIGTERM termination.

candidate_plan.title: Platform Admission Transfer Archive Staging
candidate_plan.script_implementation:
def compress_transfer_payload(tar_path, output_path):
    # Maximum compression to ensure seed image stays under 512 MiB ceiling
    argv = ['/usr/bin/xz', '-9e', '--threads=1', '--stdout', str(tar_path)]
    with open(output_path, 'wb') as out:
        subprocess.run(argv, stdout=out, check=True)
candidate_plan.proposed_execution: Execute compress_transfer_payload on incoming.tar (size: 1,388,769,280 bytes / ~1.38 GB) inside the 30-minute active work window.
candidate_plan.question: Can this plan complete within the active operational window, or does it trigger an unrecoverable timeout?
